scientific_integrity: The exact simplex minimum is proved analytically. Exact rational replay verifies the spectral witness and arithmetic identities. The source paper's independently supplied physical counterexamples are not disputed.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the source paper's displayed spectral relaxation and its \(2/5\) heuristic. The explicit spectra used here satisfy those relaxed constraints but are not claimed to arise from a physical state together with its optimal classical--quantum approximation.
title: Exact correction of the spectral relaxation behind a geometric-discord negativity threshold
